verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs describe drafting feature revisions, requesting review, resolving merge conflicts, and requiring approval before publishing (growthbook-docs-5), which covers versioning and review of flag/automation changes, but no explicit 'rollback' or revision-history restore mechanism is documented, and an older community comment notes the tool lacked code-repository-based configuration versioning (growthbook-comm-11). missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert-to-previous-version feature, GitOps/config-as-code storage, independent confirmation that review/approval flow works as described in practice.
